This knowledge site is intentionally limited to the five calibration problems named by [challenge #133: The problem factory](https://github.com/QuantumBFS/quantum.harness/issues/133). It contains only the models, methods, physics concepts, software, and exact oracles needed to generate and validate those demonstrations.

## Calibration problems

- [#124 — Close the certified energy bracket for the kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet](https://github.com/QuantumBFS/quantum.harness/issues/124): Heisenberg and frustrated-spin physics, with SDP lower bounds and DMRG, PEPS, NQS, and ED upper-bound or validation paths.
- [#125 — Beat variational SOTA for square-lattice J1–J2 at J2/J1 = 0.5](https://github.com/QuantumBFS/quantum.harness/issues/125): the J1–J2 model, frustration, VMC/NQS and PEPS, with ED checks.
- [#126 — Computer-assisted spectral-gap theorem for an open AKLT-type lattice](https://github.com/QuantumBFS/quantum.harness/issues/126): AKLT model and exact oracles, DMRG and ED, plus the gapless Heisenberg XXX chain as a negative control.
- [#127 — Beat tensor-network contraction costs](https://github.com/QuantumBFS/quantum.harness/issues/127): tensor-network circuit simulation, contraction ordering, and the quimb/cotengra implementation surface.
- [#128 — Tighter rigorous Trotter error bounds for a concrete 2D Hamiltonian](https://github.com/QuantumBFS/quantum.harness/issues/128): circuit simulation, TEBD/product formulas, Heisenberg Hamiltonians, and ED cross-checks.
